howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.heading: Connected in Under 2 Minutes
howItWorks.subheading: No store visits, no waiting, no physical SIM. Three steps to global connectivity.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Search 200+ countries and regions. Compare plans by data, duration, and price. Filter by destination or browse curated picks for popular travel spots.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Secure checkout in seconds. Your eSIM QR code is generated instantly in the app — no email, no waiting, no physical delivery needed.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Scan the QR code before departure. Your eSIM activates automatically when you land. Keep your number, drop the roaming fees.

hero.label: About Simphonia
hero.desc: We believe staying connected while traveling should be effortless, affordable, and available to everyone.

story.label: Our Story
story.quote: "I landed in Tokyo at midnight with zero mobile data. No maps, no ride, no translation. That one trip changed everything."
story.p1: That frustration — the overpriced roaming, the hunt for local SIM cards, the confusing carrier shops — became the spark behind Simphonia.
story.p2: Founded in 2024, we set out to make global connectivity instant and accessible for every traveler. Today, Simphonia covers 200+ countries with one-tap eSIM activation, transparent pricing, and 24/7 AI-powered support.

values.label: Our Values
values.heading: What Drives Us
values.v1Desc: We think globally. Every feature, every plan, every decision is made with the world traveler in mind. Coverage without borders.
values.v2Desc: Speed matters when you travel. From purchase to activation, everything happens in seconds. No waiting, no delays.
values.v3Desc: No hidden fees, no surprise charges, no fine print. What you see is what you pay. We believe trust is built through honesty.
values.v4Desc: Every feature exists because a traveler needed it. We listen, iterate, and ship relentlessly to solve real travel pain points.

cta.desc: Explore our destinations and stay connected wherever you travel.

hero.label: How It Works
hero.desc: No stores to visit, no SIM cards to swap, no contracts to sign. Just seamless global connectivity in three steps.

steps.label: The Process
steps.heading: Three Steps to Connected
steps.desc: No store visits, no waiting, no physical SIM swap required.
steps.step1Desc: Open Simphonia and browse 200+ countries. Compare plans by data, duration, and price — or let smart filters find the perfect match for your trip.
steps.step2Desc: Checkout in under 30 seconds with Apple Pay, Google Pay, or any major card. Your eSIM QR code is generated instantly — no email, no shipping, no delays.
steps.step3Desc: Scan the QR code in your phone settings before departure. Your eSIM activates automatically when you land — keep your number, drop the roaming fees.
